annotations.title: Studio: approve or reject a channel video (owner only)

description: Only for the Ania owner account (admin). Approves (`decisao: "aprovar"`, optional `motivo` = a comment of what to keep) or rejects (`decisao: "reprovar"`, `motivo` required: why, it becomes a rule of the channel) one version from studio_videos_canais. Approving a held channel releases that version to its schedule; rejecting keeps it off YouTube. The factory applies it in a few minutes. Only call it after the user said what to decide.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
